column1: # Copied verbatim from github.com/otfabric/iec104-interop tests/cases.tsv (v0.3.1, MIT).
# Refresh it when bumping the image tag; the format is described below.
# Self-test cases for scripts/interop.sh, against the baseline fixture.
#   1  state   "ro" (the case does not change the station; servers are shared)
#              "rw" (the case gets a freshly started server)
#   2  exit    expected exit code of the client
#   3  summary expected outcome: ok, error code, confirmations (cause, "n" when
#              negative), termination, and type/cause of every received ASDU
#   4  needs   "-", or features the pairing must declare in print-capabilities,
#              A pairing that lacks one skips the case.
#   5  operation and its flags, as passed to "client"
# Every case runs for every client/server pairing. Besides matching the
# expectation, all pairings must produce the same result document.
